Container.Name: File-Sync-Engine
Container.Overview: File Sync Engine ships the engine only. Set FSE_WEB_GUI_ENABLED to true to download the newest GUI package compatible with this engine schema, or supply an explicit package and checksum. Unset the variable to disable the GUI listener. Replace the repository tag with the published YYYY.MM.DD.BB release.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent config, metadata, logs, and an installed GUI when enabled.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Folder data to sync. Share subfolders from the GUI.

Config.Name: API port
Config.Description: Daemon HTTPS API. The GUI proxies this server-side.

Config.Name: Libp2p TCP
Config.Description: libp2p TCP. Other engines dial this published port for pairing records. Keep the host port equal to FSE_PUBLISHED_LIBP2P_PORT.

Config.Name: Libp2p QUIC
Config.Description: libp2p QUIC/UDP on the same port number as libp2p TCP.

Config.Name: GUI port
Config.Description: Web GUI. Nothing listens here unless FSE_WEB_GUI_ENABLED=true.

Config.Name: Sync port
Config.Description: Host port for the container sync listener. Default host port 32000 leaves Syncthing's 22000 free. The container still listens on 22000 unless FSE_SYNC_LISTEN is changed.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id. 99 is Unraid nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id. 100 is Unraid users.

Config.Name: FSE_NODE_NAME
Config.Description: Node name used the first time config is created.

Config.Name: FSE_ADVERTISE_URL
Config.Description: Optional override for the reachable API URL other engines use, for example https://192.168.1.20:22420. Leave empty. The engine learns its address from peers, the host you used to open the GUI, and UPnP or NAT-PMP, then checks that it is reachable. Docker bridge addresses are never advertised.

Config.Name: FSE_ADVERTISE_URLS
Config.Description: Optional extra reachable API URLs, comma-separated, such as a LAN address and a Tailscale address. Bridge and container-internal addresses are ignored.

Config.Name: FSE_PUBLISHED_API_PORT
Config.Description: Host port published for the API. Keep this equal to the host side of the API port mapping. The web GUI uses it with the address you opened the console on when the container cannot see a LAN or Tailscale address.

Config.Name: FSE_LIBP2P_PORT
Config.Description: TCP and QUIC/UDP port libp2p listens on inside the container. A random port cannot be reached from another host.

Config.Name: FSE_PUBLISHED_LIBP2P_PORT
Config.Description: Host port mapped to FSE_LIBP2P_PORT. Other engines dial this port. Leave it equal to the host side of the libp2p mapping.

Config.Name: FSE_WEB_GUI_ENABLED
Config.Description: true downloads or installs the GUI. false or empty disables the GUI listener.

Config.Name: FSE_WEB_GUI_VERSION
Config.Description: Explicit GUI package version. Leave empty to select the newest schema-compatible package.

Config.Name: FSE_WEB_GUI_PACKAGE
Config.Description: Absolute in-container path of an explicit GUI zip. Leave empty for catalog download.

Config.Name: FSE_WEB_GUI_INSTALL_DIR
Config.Description: Persistent GUI install directory.

Config.Name: FSE_WEB_GUI_LISTEN
Config.Description: GUI listen address inside the container.

Config.Name: FSE_WEB_GUI_CHECKSUM
Config.Description: SHA-256 of an explicit GUI package. Required together with version, package, install dir, and listen.

Config.Name: FSE_WEB_GUI_SCHEMA_INDEX
Config.Description: Catalog mapping GUI packages to engine schema versions.

Config.Name: FSE_WEB_GUI_TLS_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the optional GUI HTTPS listener.

Config.Name: FSE_WEB_GUI_HTTPS_LISTEN
Config.Description: Explicit GUI HTTPS listen address.

Config.Name: FSE_SYNC_LISTEN
Config.Description: Sync listen address inside the container. File sync between paired GUIs uses the API port.

Config.Name: FSE_UMASK
Config.Description: Umask for files the daemon creates.
